title: Halo Dental
description: Industrial-design editorial palette: warm stone paper (#f5f1ee), crisp white cards, stark black contrast bands, and a single vivid international orange (#ff5e2b) accent paired with an amber-to-vermilion headline gradient. Set in Geist at regular 400 weight throughout.
notes: Light is the faithful mode (#f5f1ee warm stone background, #ffffff cards); dark bands (hero, mission, footer) apply .dark to switch to pure #000000
Geist stands in for Halo Dental's commercial Nuckle grotesk, used at weight 400 across all headings, body copy and buttons
--highlight (#ffa41c) and --glow (#ff362a) drive the warm amber-to-orange-red display gradient
name: halodental-vague-flash-theme
